name: Inagi Koremasa
source: A man who uses hypnosis to prey on others and live off them. He does only what he wants and refuses to involve himself in anything he dislikes. Easily bored, he drifts from place to place in search of stimulation, hypnotizing various people and “playing” with them as he pleases.
